props.name: data
props.description: The data that you wish to sort or filter.

props.name: sortableAttributes
props.description:
All the attributes you want to enable sorting for and the corresponding name to display in the dropdown.
Structured as `{attributeName: "Name for dropdown", secondAttributeName: "Name for dropdown"}`

props.name: defaultSortAttribute
props.description: If set the data will be sorted by this attribute by default.

props.name: filterLabel
props.description: Label text for filter input field.

props.name: placeholderFilter
props.description:
Previously set placeholder text in filter input field.

Default is textkey "fkui.sort-filter-dataset.placeholder.filter"

props.name: defaultSortAscending
props.description: The order the data will be sorted by if defaultSortAttribute has been set.

props.name: filterAttributes
props.description:
Attributes that should be included in search when filtering by input.
Default includes all attributes.

events.name: datasetSorted
events.description: Emitted when the data is sorted.

properties.name: sortAttribute
properties.description: The attributes used when sorting the data.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Slot for header to the left of the filter dropdown. Slot content is available through `v-slot="{ <propertyName> }"`, e.g. `v-slot="{ slotClass }"`.

bindings.name: slotClass
bindings.description: CSS classes to use for the SortFilter header element. Use with `:class="slotClass"`.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Slot for displaying the data. The data is available through `v-slot="{ <propertyName> }"`, e.g. `v-slot="{ sortFilterResult }"`.
